anyOf.description: A theme colour.
A `#rrggbb` hex code, validated on the way in.

AgentColor.description:
An agent's colour: a six-digit hex code, or a theme colour
(`config/agent.ts:7-10`).

AgentConfig.description:
One entry of the `agents` map, or one Markdown agent definition's frontmatter.

Deserialization performs the oracle's sweep: any key this struct does not name
is copied into [`options`](Self::options) *and* kept verbatim in
[`extra`](Self::extra).

delegates.description: Exact child-agent allowlist for direct delegation and workflows.

hidden.description: Hide the agent from the `@` autocomplete menu.

mode.description: Where the agent may be used.

options.description: Provider options, including every swept unknown key.

reasoning.description: Provider-neutral reasoning level, applied only with the configured model.

requiredSkills.description: Skills loaded at the start of every turn for this agent.

steps.description:
Optional maximum tool-capable iterations before one text-only finalization request.

When omitted, the agent has no fixed step limit.

tools.description: Exact model-visible tool allowlist for this agent.

variant.description: Default model variant, applied only with the agent's configured model.

AgentMode.description: Where an agent may be used (`config/agent.ts:26`).

oneOf.description: Only reachable as a primary agent.

AgentReasoning.description: Provider-neutral reasoning level selected for this agent.

oneOf.description: Use the strongest broadly available effort.
Use the strongest effort exposed by the model.

maxAgents.description: Maximum nodes admitted into one run. Defaults to twelve.

maxParallel.description: Maximum simultaneously running nodes. Defaults to four.

nodes.description: The immutable DAG instantiated by the model-facing workflow tool.

agent.description: Agent to run the command as.

model.description: Model to run the command with.

subtask.description: Run the command in a subtask instead of the current session.

template.description: The prompt template. The only required field in the whole schema's leaves.

variant.description: Model variant to run the command with.

auto.description: Compact automatically when the context fills. Defaults to true.

preserve_recent_tokens.description: Token ceiling for the verbatim tail.

prune.description: Prune old tool outputs. Defaults to false.

reserved.description: Token buffer left free so compaction itself cannot overflow.

tail_turns.description: Recent user turns to keep verbatim. Defaults to 2.

threshold_percent.description:
Percentage of the usable context window that triggers automatic compaction.
Defaults to 80.

delegations.description: Maximum native or product-agent delegations executing at once.

lsp_requests.description: Maximum independent LSP servers or file requests executing at once.

mcp_connections.description: Maximum MCP servers connecting or disconnecting at once.

tool_calls.description: Maximum independent model-issued tool calls executing at once.

ConcurrencyLimit.description: Small positive concurrency bound accepted at every runtime boundary.

anyOf.description: `false` disables both tools; `true` enables both.
Fine-grained selection. Unspecified fields remain disabled.

ContinuityConfig.description: Model-facing continuity: a master boolean, or independently selected tools.

ContinuityOptions.description: Fine-grained switches under the `continuity` top-level key.

history.description: Expose normalized history from the current session.

anyOf.description: Enable or disable every formatter at once.
Per-formatter overrides, keyed by formatter name.

FormatterConfig.description:
The `formatter` key: a switch, or per-formatter overrides.

Omitted disables formatting, `true` enables the built-ins, and an object
enables the built-ins with the listed overrides applied.

GitReference.description: A reference to a git repository (`config/reference.ts:5-10`).

retry.description: Automatic recovery after a retryable terminal turn failure.

GoalRetryConfig.description: Exponential backoff settings for automatic goal recovery.

initial_delay_ms.description: Delay before the first retry, in milliseconds.

jitter_percent.description: Symmetric jitter percentage for locally selected delays, in the inclusive range 0..=100.

max_delay_ms.description: Maximum delay between retries, in milliseconds.

poll_interval_ms.description: Maximum wait before checking for queued human input, in milliseconds.

auto_resize.description: Resize oversized images instead of rejecting them. Defaults to true.

max_encoded_bytes.description: Maximum normalized encoded bytes. Defaults to 5 MiB.

max_height.description: Maximum height before resizing or rejecting. Defaults to 2000.

max_pixels.description: Maximum decoded pixel count. Defaults to 4,000,000.

max_source_bytes.description: Maximum source bytes accepted before decoding. Defaults to 20 MiB.

max_width.description: Maximum width before resizing or rejecting. Defaults to 2000.

anyOf.description: Switch interleaved reasoning on or off.
The stream field carrying reasoning.
The same, spelled as an object.

Interleaved.description:
Interleaved-reasoning configuration (`config/provider.ts:22-30`).

The oracle's field arm is `Union([Literals([...]), String])`, which accepts any
string; the three literals are documentation, not a constraint.

LearningConfig.description: User-experience extraction and reviewed Skill evolution.

enabled.description: Master switch. Defaults to false and caps both `use` and `generate`.

extractor_model.description:
Dedicated model used by the no-tools structured extractor.

Required only when effective generation is enabled.

generate.description:
Generate new Experience, Memory candidates, patterns, and Skill candidates.

Defaults to true when `enabled` is true. The extractor model is required only
when this resolves to true.

use.description:
Use durable Experience records produced by earlier runs.

Defaults to true when `enabled` is true. The master switch remains an upper
bound, so `enabled: false` disables use even when this field is true.

disable_on_external_context.description:
Skip automatic extraction when the completed turn consumed external context.
Defaults to false.

enabled.description:
Enable automatic extraction after an eligible completed task. Defaults to true
when effective generation is enabled.

idle_delay_ms.description:
Delay before an automatic extraction job becomes runnable. Defaults to
21600000 milliseconds (six hours).

Zero keeps automatic extraction immediate.

max_jobs_per_wake.description: Maximum automatic extraction jobs admitted by one worker wake. Defaults to 2.

poll_interval_ms.description: Interval between background queue polls. Defaults to 60000 milliseconds.

LocalReference.description: A reference to a local directory (`config/reference.ts:12-16`).

anyOf.description: Enable or disable every server at once.
Per-server overrides, keyed by server id.

LspConfig.description:
The `lsp` key: a switch, or per-server overrides.

Omitted disables LSP, `true` enables the built-ins, and an object enables the
built-ins with the listed overrides applied.

LspEntry.description:
One LSP server's configuration.

The oracle spells this as a union of `{ disabled: true }` and `{ command, ... }`.
Collapsing it into one struct with the same requirement — `command` is
mandatory unless the server is switched off — accepts and rejects exactly the
same documents while keeping every key the author wrote, which the union arm
order would otherwise discard.

command.description: Command and arguments to run the server.

cwd.description: Working directory; relative paths resolve from the workspace directory.

environment.description: Environment variables for the server process.

timeout.description: Request timeout in milliseconds; the runtime defaults to 5000.

anyOf.description: Explicit OAuth settings.
The literal `false`.

McpOauth.description:
The `oauth` key: settings, or `false` to disable auto-detection
(`config/mcp.ts:53-55`).

McpOauthConfig.description: OAuth settings for a remote MCP server (`config/mcp.ts:26-41`).

callbackPort.description:
Port for the local callback server; the runtime defaults to 19876.

`NonZeroU16` reproduces the oracle's `Int.isBetween(1, 65535)` exactly.

clientId.description: Client id; absent means dynamic client registration (RFC 7591).

clientSecret.description: Client secret, when the authorization server requires one.

oauth.description: OAuth settings, or `false` to suppress OAuth auto-detection.

timeout.description: Request timeout in milliseconds; the runtime defaults to 5000.

anyOf.description: A locally spawned server.
A remote server.
A switch for a server defined by another config layer.

McpServerConfig.description:
One entry of the `mcp` map.

The arms are tried in the oracle's union order — local, remote, then the
enabled-only toggle — and the first that fits wins.

McpToggle.description:
A switch for a server another config layer defined
(`config/config.ts:113-115`).

MemoryConfidence.description: A validated probability used by memory promotion.

anyOf.description: `false` disables the subsystem; `true` selects all defaults.
Fine-grained settings for an enabled subsystem.

MemoryConfig.description: Persistent memory: a master boolean, or component settings.

MemoryOptions.description: Fine-grained settings under the `memory` top-level key.

global_char_limit.description: Character cap for global agent notes. Defaults to 2200.

project_char_limit.description: Character cap for project rules. Defaults to 3000.

resident.description: Inject frozen resident blocks into each session's system prompt.

MemoryPromotion.description: How durable memory candidates become resident entries.

oneOf.description: Keep every candidate pending until a user approves it.
Apply only candidates at or above `auto_confidence`.

Modality.description: A modality a model accepts or emits (`config/provider.ts:56-59`).

ModelConfig.description: One entry of a provider's `models` map (`config/provider.ts:13-80`).

headers.description: Extra headers for requests to this model.

options.description: Model options handed to the provider SDK.

provider.description: The native transport and API endpoint backing this model.

tool_call.description: Whether the model can call tools.

context_over_200k.description: Pricing that takes over past a 200k-token context.

ModelProvider.description: The native transport and API endpoint backing a single model.

surface.description: Request surface override for this model.

transport.description: Native request transport implemented by Zuno.

ModelVariant.description:
One named variant of a model (`config/provider.ts:69-79`).

`StructWithRest`: everything but `disabled` is variant-specific payload.

disabled.description: Disable this variant for the model.

NavigationConfig.description:
How much the runtime asks of a code-intelligence index before reading source.

Off by default. An index is a per-repository choice, and a runtime that refused to
read a file until somebody set one up would be unusable in every repository that
has not.

codegraph.description: What to do when a call reads source before the CodeGraph index was consulted.

NavigationGate.description: The three answers to "a search ran before the index was asked anything".

oneOf.description: Allow every call and record nothing. The default.
Report the session's first such call and then leave it alone.
Fail such a call until the index has been queried once.

PermissionAction.description: What to do when a tool asks (`config/permission.ts:5`).

PermissionConfig.description: The canonical permission configuration used by Zuno.

mode.description: How unresolved and side-effecting calls are admitted.

rules.description:
Ordered per-tool rules, keyed by permission key. Explicit denies remain
terminal in every mode. A key that only aliases another key — `write`,
`apply_patch`, and the three MCP resource tools — is rejected, because
such a rule can never match.

PermissionMode.description: Cross-cutting human-in-the-loop behavior for tool calls.

oneOf.description: Apply configured rules and the normal risk gates.
Require a fresh decision for every side-effecting call.
Skip HITL prompts while preserving explicit denies and sandbox validation.

PermissionObject.description: Per-tool permission rules, in the author's key order.

anyOf.description: One action covering every invocation of the tool.
Per-pattern actions, evaluated in the author's key order.

PermissionRule.description:
A permission rule: one action for the whole tool, or per-pattern actions
(`config/permission.ts:8-12`).

PresetConfig.description:
One named team preset.

Agent routes drive direct and delegated agent selection. Categories are optional
semantic shorthands for workflow nodes that should not hard-code an agent name.

anyOf.description: A qualified `provider/model` id with no reasoning override.
A qualified model plus its canonical reasoning level.

PresetModelConfig.description:
One model choice inside a preset.

A string is the concise form. The object form adds a provider-neutral reasoning
level without exposing provider-specific option objects in the team preset.

PresetModelOptions.description: The expanded form of a preset model choice.

reasoning.description: Provider-neutral reasoning level for this route.

command.description: Executable or executable path. Defaults to the product's normal command.

env.description:
Additional child-process environment values.

Ordinary process variables, including proxy variables, are inherited even when
this map is absent. These entries only overlay that inherited environment.

kind.description: Which native product implements this instance.

oneOf.description: OpenAI Codex CLI through its app-server protocol.
Anthropic Claude Code through its non-interactive stream-json CLI.

ProductAgentPermissionMode.description:
Native permission vocabulary accepted by either supported product.

Validation keeps product-specific values from crossing the boundary. One enum
keeps the JSON schema useful while [`ProductAgentConfig::validate`] enforces the
actual Codex/Claude Code split.

oneOf.description: Codex: never ask Zuno for approval.
Codex: ask only for commands outside its trusted set.
Codex: request approval when its policy requires it.
Claude Code asks before protected operations. Zuno still disables interactive questions.
Claude Code selects its own non-interactive policy.
Claude Code may apply edits without asking.
Claude Code refuses operations that would require a prompt.

anyOf.description: `true` trusts every checkout on this host; `false` trusts none.

Absolute directories whose project config layers are trusted.

A layer is trusted when its file lives inside one of these roots. Relative
entries are refused: a trust decision that depends on the current directory
is not a decision.

ProjectHostCommands.description: Whose project config may declare a host command.

api.description: Base API URL for the provider.

env.description: Environment variables that supply this provider's credentials.

headers.description: Default extra HTTP headers for every model in this provider.

options.description: Provider-level options, including SDK options this schema does not name.

surface.description: Default request surface for this provider's models.

transport.description: Native request transport implemented by Zuno.

whitelist.description: Models to keep, to the exclusion of the rest.

ProviderOptions.description:
Provider options (`config/provider.ts:90-124`).

The oracle spells this `StructWithRest(..., [Record(String, Any)])`, so any key
the schema does not name is still valid and is handed to the provider SDK. That
rest record is [`ProviderOptions::extra`].

chunkTimeout.description: Maximum gap between streamed SSE chunks, in milliseconds.

enterpriseUrl.description: GitHub Enterprise URL, for copilot authentication.

headerTimeout.description: Response-header timeout in milliseconds, or `false` for none.

reasoningReplay.description:
Whether an OpenAI Responses endpoint is asked for provider-sealed reasoning.

`encrypted` adds `include: ["reasoning.encrypted_content"]` to every Responses
request and echoes each sealed reasoning item back verbatim on later requests.
Endpoints that seal reasoning bind the envelope to a model and a conversation,
so replay is scoped to the model that minted it.

reasoningReplayMaxAge.description:
Oldest sealed reasoning envelope, in milliseconds, that Zuno still replays.

A sealed envelope usually expires upstream. An expired envelope stays in
durable history and leaves the provider request instead of being rejected on
the wire. Requires [`ProviderOptions::reasoning_replay`] to be `encrypted`.

responsesTextBlocks.description:
How a Responses-compatible endpoint accepts text content inside one message.

Standards-compatible endpoints accept multiple `input_text` blocks. Some
gateways project a message onto one upstream text field and therefore need
Zuno to coalesce those blocks at the provider boundary.

timeout.description: Whole-request timeout in milliseconds, or `false` for none.

ProviderSurface.description:
Native API surface selected independently from the wire transport.

`transport: "openai"` says which protocol family Zuno implements. `surface`
selects the concrete endpoint shape within that family, so a custom gateway can
explicitly use Responses instead of falling back to Chat Completions.

ProviderTransport.description: Native provider transports implemented by the Rust workspace.

oneOf.description: Bedrock through the Mantle OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
OpenRouter's OpenAI-compatible transport and reasoning options.

ReasoningReplay.description:
Whether Zuno requests and replays provider-sealed reasoning
(`include: ["reasoning.encrypted_content"]`).

This is an endpoint capability, not a provider identity: a loopback gateway and
the official OpenAI Responses API both declare it through this option.

oneOf.description: Never ask for a sealed reasoning envelope. Reasoning stays history only.
Ask for `reasoning.encrypted_content` and echo sealed items back verbatim.

anyOf.description: The shorthand form: a bare repository or path string.
A git repository reference.
A local directory reference.

ReferenceEntry.description:
One entry of the `references` map.

The arms are disjoint: a string is a string, [`GitReference`] requires
`repository`, and [`LocalReference`] requires `path`.

ResponsesTextBlocks.description: Text-block shape accepted by an OpenAI Responses-compatible endpoint.

oneOf.description: Preserve each typed text or resource projection as its own `input_text`.
Join every projected text fragment into one stable `input_text` block.

RuntimeConfig.description: Ceilings the deployment puts on the component runtime.

max_component_stop_ms.description:
Longest this host waits for one component to stop, in milliseconds.

A component asks for its own stop budget; this ceiling shortens a request
that is longer than the deployment tolerates. `0` or absent means the host
imposes no ceiling and every component keeps the budget it asked for.
Shortening the wait never cancels the component: disposal stays reverse
registration order, and an overrunning disposer is left running to
completion so process-tree reaping still happens.

SandboxBackendSelection.description:
Which execution backend resolves model-initiated Shell calls.

Orthogonal to `mode`: the mode is the authority an Agent is granted, the
backend is what enforces it. `native` enforces nothing at the OS level and
says so in every record and notice.

oneOf.description:
Discover the platform's confined backend and apply `onUnavailable` when it
cannot be deployed.

Run every Agent's Shell, read-only contracts included, on the native process
backend with the configured permission mode kept. The requested authority is
recorded but not OS-enforced.

SandboxConfig.description: Policy additions shared by every Shell call in one resolved profile.

backend.description:
Backend selection. `auto` (default) discovers the platform's confined
backend and applies `onUnavailable`. `native` runs every Agent's Shell,
read-only contracts included, on the native process backend with the
configured permission mode kept; the requested authority is recorded but
not OS-enforced. Accepted only from a trusted configuration layer.

mode.description:
Maximum Shell authority for this invocation. Absence defaults to
`workspace-write`; read-only Agent contracts still narrow it.

network.description:
Network authority. Absence defaults to `deny` in confined modes and to
host networking in `danger-full-access`; that mode rejects explicit
`deny` because it cannot enforce it.

onUnavailable.description:
Action when a confined backend is unavailable. Absence fails closed.

`run-unconfined` is accepted only from a trusted configuration layer.

protectedPaths.description:
Paths reapplied read-only after writable roots are mounted.

Relative paths resolve against the active workspace. Each entry must
already exist and must not be a symbolic link; deployment fails closed
rather than starting an Agent whose protection was silently dropped.
Cannot be combined with `danger-full-access`, which has no confined
backend to enforce it.

writableRoots.description:
Existing directories writable in addition to the workspace for write-capable Agents.

Relative paths resolve against the active workspace.

SandboxMode.description: Filesystem/process confinement selected for model-initiated Shell calls.

oneOf.description: Read the host filesystem, but do not permit host writes.
Write the active workspace and explicitly trusted extra roots.
Run as the Zuno user with the host filesystem, processes, and network.

SandboxNetworkMode.description: Network authority available to model-initiated Shell calls.

oneOf.description: Create a private network namespace and deny network syscalls.

SandboxUnavailableAction.description: Runtime action when a confined OS backend cannot be deployed.

oneOf.description: Refuse to publish or execute Shell without the requested confinement.
Run through the native process backend after an eligible deployment failure.

ServerConfig.description:
What the HTTP server binds to.

Closed: a key here that Zuno does not read is a promise it cannot keep, so an
unknown key is a validation error rather than a silently ignored one.

SkillCatalogExposure.description: How one enabled Skill participates in model-driven discovery.

oneOf.description: Advertise the Skill in the initial bounded index and in search.
Keep it out of the initial index but retain it in `skill search` and `list`.
Permit only explicit invocation, such as `/<name>` or `requiredSkills`.

SkillPathConfig.description: One exact or recursive path override under [`SkillsConfig::config`].

enabled.description: Whether matching Skills are loaded. Omitted means enabled.

path.description: Skill directory, `SKILL.md`, or subtree root when `recursive` is true.

recursive.description: Apply this entry to every Skill below `path`.

SkillsConfig.description: Skill discovery and model-visible catalog settings.

config.description:
Per-path Skill enablement and model-discovery overrides.

Entries are evaluated in order and the last matching entry wins.

includeInstructions.description: Whether turns receive the skill trigger policy and metadata catalog.

maxContextTokens.description:
Maximum approximate tokens used by the catalog. Values above 10,000 are
clamped by the runtime.

maxSelectedContextTokens.description:
Maximum approximate tokens used by all fully selected Skill bodies in one
session prompt. Values above the runtime ceiling are clamped.

SubagentModelSelectionConfig.description: Host-global child model selection policy, frozen into each durable session.

allowed_models.description: Exact `provider/model` identities the model may select.

enabled.description: Expose optional `model` and `effort` fields on the `task` tool.

anyOf.description: Milliseconds to wait.
The literal `false`.

Timeout.description:
A timeout in milliseconds, or `false` to disable it
(`config/provider.ts:101-116`).

ToolOutputConfig.description:
The size at which tool output stops being model-visible.

Output over either limit is persisted in full and then withheld: the model
receives a pointer and the measured cost instead of a prefix, and must accept
the context cost explicitly to read it.

max_bytes.description:
Bytes of output the model may receive directly. Defaults to 51200. Output above this
is saved whole and read back through `bg`, never truncated.

max_lines.description:
Lines of output the model may receive directly. Defaults to 2000. Output above this
is saved whole and read back through `bg`, never truncated.

TrustConfig.description:
Trust this host extends to configuration a checkout controls.

This section is only honoured from a trusted layer. A project layer that sets
it at all is refused, so a checkout cannot widen its own authority.

project_host_commands.description:
Which checkouts may declare commands this machine runs.

Absent refuses every project-layer `shell`, local `mcp` server, `lsp`,
`formatter`, and `productAgent` command.

WebSearchBackend.description: Hosted web-search providers supported by the built-in adapter.

WebSearchConfig.description: Web-search settings owned by the active profile.

enabled.description: Master switch. Absence enables anonymous Exa by default.

max_queries.description: Maximum queries accepted in one model call.

max_results.description: Maximum sources returned after combining all queries.

provider.description: Hosted provider selected for this profile.

timeout_ms.description: Per-query provider time budget in milliseconds.

WorkflowNodeConfig.description: One node in a configured workflow DAG.

agent.description: Configured or built-in agent to run.

dependsOn.description: Node ids that must complete successfully first.

description.description: Human-readable purpose shown in runtime projections.

id.description: Stable node id within the template.

prompt.description: Optional node-specific instruction appended to the run prompt.

description: Configuration accepted from zuno.json and zuno.jsonc layers. TUI-only settings such as theme and mouse belong in tui.json.

$schema.description: JSON schema reference for editor validation.

agents.description:
Agent definitions and overrides, keyed by agent name.

The oracle names `plan`, `build`, `general`, `explore`, `title`, `summary`,
and `compaction` explicitly and then adds `Record(String, AgentConfig)`
(`config/config.ts:96-110`), so every value has the same type and the named
keys carry no extra meaning at parse time.

command.description: Custom commands, keyed by command name.

concurrency.description: Bounded concurrency for independent runtime capabilities.

continuity.description: Optional model-facing access to durable session history and notes.

default_agent.description: Agent to use when none is named. Must be a primary agent.

disabled_providers.description: Providers to drop even when their credentials are present.

enabled_providers.description: When set, the only providers to enable.

formatter.description: Formatters: a switch, or per-formatter overrides.

goal.description: Persistent goal continuation and retry settings.

instructions.description: Additional instruction files or glob patterns.

learning.description: User-experience extraction, retrieval, aggregation, and Skill review.

lsp.description: LSP servers: a switch, or per-server overrides.

memory.description: Persistent resident-memory configuration. Absent defaults to enabled.

navigation.description: What the runtime asks of a code-intelligence index before reading source.

permission.description: Global permissions and cross-cutting HITL mode.

productAgent.description: Native Codex and Claude Code subagent instances.

references.description: Named git or local directory references.

runtime.description: Deployment ceilings for the component runtime that owns shutdown.

sandbox.description: Native OS sandbox policy for model-initiated Shell calls.

server.description: Server configuration for `zuno serve` and the web command.

shell.description: Default shell for terminals and the model-facing Shell tool.

skills.description: Skill discovery and model-visible catalog settings.

small_model.description: Model for cheap side tasks such as title generation.

snapshot.description: Record filesystem snapshots so edits can be undone. Defaults to true.

subagent_depth.description: Maximum subagent nesting depth. Defaults to 1.

subagent_model_selection.description: Host-owned allowlist for model-facing child model and effort selection.

tool_output.description: Size limits above which tool output is withheld from the model.

tools.description: Tool switches, keyed by tool name.

trust.description: Trust this host extends to project checkouts. Never readable from a project layer.

web_search.description: Web-search provider and runtime-owned batch limits.
